name_zh: 波尔查诺-魏尔斯特拉斯定理
canonical_name: Bolzano-Weierstrass bounded-sequence theorem family (real-analysis formulation; exact source proposition open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 有界数列必有收敛子列
literal_source_claim_en: Every bounded sequence has a convergent subsequence.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not specify the sequence codomain, boundedness encoding, convergence topology, subsequence object, ordered binders, limit-location clause, or exact source proposition. Real-analysis placement strongly suggests real-valued sequences, but selecting Real rather than a finite-dimensional or proper metric carrier, and selecting range-boundedness plus a StrictMono selector, require an admitted source and independent review. THM-M-0619 separately owns the compact-metric-space formulation.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall x : Nat -> Real, Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range x) -> exists a : Real, exists phi : Nat -> Nat, StrictMono phi and Filter.Tendsto (x composed with phi) Filter.atTop (nhds a)
canonical_formal_target.candidate_relationship: The first declaration is explicitly documented as Bolzano-Weierstrass for bounded sequences in proper metric spaces. Specializing X to Real and s to the sequence range yields the conventional candidate root after discarding a stronger closure-membership conclusion, but no source-approved checked specialization is frozen at intake.

domain_and_universes: Open: the conventional candidate uses a Nat-indexed Real sequence in the base universe, while the pinned declaration is universe-polymorphic over a proper pseudometric space. An admitted source must fix the carrier, topology, index and typeclass context.
conclusion: Open: expected family is existence of a strictly indexed convergent subsequence, but the catalog does not state the limit carrier, closure membership, selector encoding, topology, or binder order.
